native_driver_followup_006.observed: After Cancel the unique button is laid out and its center is in the viewport, but the center fails hit testing. No dialog, inert state, animation or body lock was observed. Confirm was never clicked.
native_driver_followup_006.proven_source_gap: The driver used only the full bounding-box center, ignoring overflow ancestor clipping. Viewport membership does not imply that point belongs to the visible hit-test area. A partially clipped or partially occluded button can remain reachable by native input at another interior point.
native_driver_followup_006.causality_limit: 006 omitted actual target/scroller geometry and occluding-element category. Nested clipping is a concrete driver gap, not a proven retrospective cause of 006 or 001/002.
